technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals present, but severe structural weakness (price below all major MAs, weak trend, no volume confirmation) and conflicting momentum indicators make this a low-probability entry despite technical bounce setup.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional activity, no government contracts, no lobbying, minimal retail interest, and earnings 1420 days away—insufficient fundamental or smart money signals to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional activity (217+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (405.28) with flat yield curve, imminent FOMC event in 1 day, and negative macro score (-5) create severe near-term headwinds for financials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend reversal signal present contrarian buy opportunity in fear-driven market (VIX crisis, 10/100 sentiment).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structurally broken below all major moving averages with zero volume/momentum confirmation, FOMC event in 1 day, macro environment severely unfavourable (-5 score), and fundamental/smart money signals completely absent—bounce setup lacks conviction and timing risk is acute.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend reversal present technical bounce setup; contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX 405, sentiment 10/100) offers asymmetric risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 1 day combined with macro crisis environment (-5 score) and price structurally below all major moving averages creates acute timing risk that overshadows technical bounce setup.
